To the FOIA Officer of Aurora Police Department,

This request is made under Illinois Freedom of Information Act. for the following records:

1. Any Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request or other records request received by your agency from the Office of the Illinois Secretary of State concerning Automatic License Plate Reader (ALPR) systems or 625 ILCS 5/2-130, from January 1, 2025 to the date of this request.

2. All records produced by your agency in response to any request identified in Item 1, in the original electronic format in which they were produced (for example, .csv or .xlsx for audit data).

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

If any fees apply, please provide an estimate of the total charges before fulfilling this request. Electronic delivery is the preferred method of receipt.

A response is anticipated within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Thank you for your assistance.
M

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Illinois Freedom of Information Act., I hereby request the following records:

Use of force (UOF) data dating from January 1, 2025 to the date this request is processed. This data should be in database or spreadsheet format and include the case number, incident date, incident time, subject injured indicator, subject injury force related info (e.g. Yes or No), subject age, subject gender, subject ethnicity, subject weapon type, incident area occurred, force type, officer badge number and names associated with the officers involved. If one or more of these fields is unavailable, provide all fields and/or information that is available responsive to my request.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

M
